faqs.q: How do I convert an hourly rate to an annual salary for a midwife in QLD?
faqs.a: Multiply your hourly rate by the number of hours you work each week, then by 52. For a full-time midwife on a 38-hour week, annual gross = hourly × 38 × 52. The estimate uses the full tax-free threshold and 2025–26 single reduction thresholds for Medicare. HELP, surcharge, and salary packaging are not deducted.

faqs.q: Does the QLD average weekly earnings figure apply to midwives?

bodyMarkdown:
## Converting Hourly to Annual: The 38-Hour Week and Fortnight

If you are researching **midwife salary QLD**, the first step is understanding how to turn an hourly rate into annual, fortnightly, and weekly figures. This guide uses the standard full-time week of 38 hours, as defined by the Fair Work Ombudsman, and the 52-week year. The formula is straightforward: **hourly rate × hours per week × 52**.

For example, the National Minimum Wage from 1 July 2026 is $26.44 per hour. For a 38-hour week, that gives:
- Weekly: $26.44 × 38 = $1,004.90
- Fortnightly: $1,004.90 × 2 = $2,009.80
- Annual: $26.44 × 38 × 52 = $52,254.88 (before tax and super)

This same method applies to any hourly rate, including those for midwives. Remember that the annual figure assumes you work the same hours every week, with no unpaid overtime, penalty rates, or allowances. It is a base estimate.

### Fortnightly Pay and Budgeting

Many employers pay fortnightly. To find your gross fortnightly pay, simply double your weekly amount. For a midwife earning $45 per hour (a typical award rate for a registered nurse/midwife under the Nurses Award), the fortnightly gross would be $45 × 38 × 2 = $3,420. This helps when comparing salary offers or planning your budget.

### Tax and Medicare Levy

Your take-home pay depends on tax and the Medicare levy. The Australian Taxation Office sets the 2026–27 resident tax rates:
- $0 – $18,200: nil
- $18,201 – $45,000: 15%
- $45,001 – $135,000: 30%
- $135,001 – $190,000: 37%
- Over $190,000: 45%

Medicare levy is generally 2% of taxable income. The estimate here uses the 2025–26 single reduction thresholds, as the 2026–27 thresholds were not confirmed. No HELP, Medicare levy surcharge, or salary packaging is deducted. For a midwife salary QLD of $88,920 per year ($45/hour × 38 × 52), the estimated tax and Medicare would be approximately $18,467, leaving about $70,453 after tax (before super).

### Super Guarantee Paid on Top

Superannuation is paid on top of your gross salary. From 1 July 2026, the super guarantee is 12% of ordinary earnings, up to the maximum contribution base of $270,830. For the $45/hour example, super would be $45 × 38 × 52 × 0.12 = $10,670.40 per year. This is not deducted from your pay; it is an additional contribution from your employer. Always check your award or contract, as some agreements may specify a different super rate.

### Award Rates and Casual Loading

Most midwives in QLD are covered by the Nurses Award 2020, which sets minimum hourly rates based on classification and experience. These award rates are higher than the National Minimum Wage. If you work as a casual midwife, you are entitled to a 25% casual loading on top of the base award rate. The [casual loading](/topics/casual-loading) is added to your hourly rate before calculating annual pay. Never enter a rate that already includes casual loading into the timesheet; use the base rate and check the casual loading box.

### Queensland Average Earnings vs. Midwife Pay

The Australian Bureau of Statistics reports that Queensland full-time adult ordinary time earnings averaged $2,039.70 per week in May 2026. This is an average across all occupations and industries, not the median for a midwife salary QLD. Your actual pay depends on your award classification, experience, and employer. Use the hourly conversion method with your specific rate.

For more details, refer to the [minimum wage](/topics/minimum-wage) page for current rates, and [super and packaging](/topics/super-and-packaging) for super guarantee rules. The [reference tables](/data) provide additional pay benchmarks.

### Important Disclaimer

Annual pay here is hourly rate × hours per week × 52. It assumes the same rate every week, no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, no allowances, and no salary sacrifice. Super is estimated at 12% of ordinary earnings only, paid on top, and stops at the $270,830 maximum contribution base. Tax is the 2026–27 resident scale with the full tax-free threshold. Medicare uses the 2025–26 single reduction thresholds because the 2026–27 reduction thresholds were not confirmed here. HELP, the Medicare levy surcharge, and salary packaging are not deducted. This is an estimate, not a determination of your pay or tax.
